scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
short_description: Provides cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year to poor and vulnerable families.
eligibility: Families identified based on SECC 2011 deprivation and occupational criteria for rural and urban areas, RSBY beneficiaries, and senior citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income.

short_description: A direct benefit transfer maternity incentive scheme providing financial assistance to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health and nutrition.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women for their first living child (and second child if girl child) belonging to socially and economically disadvantaged sections as per MoWCD norms.

short_description: A safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission that promotes institutional delivery through conditional cash transfers.
eligibility: Eligible pregnant women delivering in government health centers or accredited private hospitals, specifically targeting low-performing states and BPL/SC/ST mothers.

short_description: Entitles pregnant women delivering in public health institutions and sick neonates up to 1 year of age to completely free and cashless healthcare services and transport.
eligibility: All pregnant women delivering in public health facilities and all sick infants up to 1 year accessing government healthcare institutions.

short_description: Ensures comprehensive and quality antenatal care (ANC) with free health checkups and specialist consultations to all pregnant women on the 9th of every month.
eligibility: All pregnant women in their 2nd and 3rd trimesters visiting designated public health facilities and participating private clinics.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Health and Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandir)
short_description: Transforms primary health centers into comprehensive primary healthcare centers providing free essential drugs, diagnostics, and wellness screening.
eligibility: Open to all citizens seeking comprehensive primary healthcare, wellness counseling, and screening for communicable and non-communicable diseases.

short_description: Provides free haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis services to Below Poverty Line (BPL) patients and subsidized services to non-BPL patients at district hospitals.
eligibility: Patients suffering from end-stage renal disease (ESRD); fully free for Below Poverty Line (BPL) families at district hospitals under PPP mode.

short_description: Provides one-time financial assistance of up to Rs. 15 lakh to poor patients suffering from major life-threatening diseases for treatment at super-specialty government hospitals.
eligibility: Patients living below poverty line (BPL) suffering from specified life-threatening ailments treated at empanelled central government super-specialty hospitals.

scheme_name: National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP) - Nikshay Poshan Yojana
short_description: Provides free TB diagnosis and treatment along with a direct benefit transfer of Rs. 500 per month as nutritional support to all notified TB patients.
eligibility: All tuberculosis patients notified on the national Nikshay portal and undergoing active anti-tubercular treatment.

short_description: A child health screening and early intervention initiative covering 4Ds: Defects at birth, Deficiencies, Diseases, and Developmental delays including disability.
eligibility: All children from birth up to 18 years enrolled in government/aided schools, Anganwadi centers, and born at public health facilities.

scheme_name: National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD)
short_description: Provides screening, early diagnosis, and free treatment for hypertension, diabetes, and common cancers (oral, breast, and cervical) at primary and secondary healthcare levels.
eligibility: All adult citizens aged 30 years and above undergoing population-based NCD screening at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs and community centers.

short_description: Provides free vaccination against 12 vaccine-preventable life-threatening diseases for pregnant women and children across India.
eligibility: All children up to 2 years of age and pregnant women who have missed or dropped out from routine immunization schedules.

short_description: Enables citizens to create a 14-digit digital health ID (ABHA) to securely store, manage, and share electronic health records and diagnostic reports with doctors.
eligibility: Available to all citizens of India holding a valid Aadhaar card or mobile number.

short_description: Provides comprehensive medical care and outpatient/inpatient coverage to central government employees, pensioners, and their recognized dependents.
eligibility: Serving Central Government employees, pensioners, sitting and ex-Members of Parliament, and other eligible categories specified by MoHFW.

short_description: Provides comprehensive all-inclusive healthcare and cashless treatment to retired Armed Forces personnel and their eligible dependants through polyclinics and empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Ex-servicemen pensioners from Army, Navy, Air Force, and their legally recognized dependants.

short_description: Provides round-the-clock free mental health counseling, psychiatric tele-consultation, and treatment support across all Indian states and Union Territories.
eligibility: Open to all individuals, students, youth, and families seeking psychological first-aid, stress management, or mental health support via toll-free helpline 14416.

scheme_name: National AIDS and STD Control Programme (NACP)
short_description: Provides free HIV screening, counseling, antiretroviral therapy (ART), and viral load testing across public ART centres and link centers nationwide.
eligibility: All individuals seeking HIV testing, prevention services, or undergoing anti-retroviral treatment across NACO-designated health facilities.

scheme_name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE)
short_description: Dedicated healthcare program providing accessible, specialized, and comprehensive geriatric care at primary, district, and regional super-specialty levels.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above seeking preventive, curative, and rehabilitative geriatric medical care.

scheme_name: National Programme for Prevention and Control of Deafness (NPPCD)
short_description: Aims to prevent hearing loss, provide early screening for hearing impairments, and distribute free hearing aids and cochlear implants to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility: Persons with hearing impairment and children diagnosed with congenital or acquired hearing loss at public health screening centers.

scheme_name: PM Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM)
short_description: Strengthens grassroots public health infrastructure, critical care hospital blocks, disease surveillance networks, and diagnostic laboratories across India.
eligibility: Strengthens public healthcare systems; benefits all citizens accessing district public hospitals, block public health units, and diagnostic labs.

scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
short_description: Cashless health insurance coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for identified surgical and medical procedures in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Families holding Yellow/Orange/White ration cards, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), or Annapurna cards residing in Maharashtra.

short_description: Provides cashless medical and surgical treatment coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for catastrophic illnesses in Gujarat.
eligibility: Families with annual family income up to Rs. 4 lakh, BPL families, accredited journalists, and senior citizens residing in Gujarat.

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
short_description: Provides cashless hospitalisation coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility: Resident families of Tamil Nadu whose annual household income is below the prescribed threshold (Rs. 1.20 lakh/year) and Sri Lankan refugees.

short_description: Provides cashless healthcare and tertiary inpatient medical treatment for serious ailments to poor and lower-middle-class families in Andhra Pradesh.
eligibility: Families holding Dr. YSR Aarogyasri health cards or White ration cards with annual family income up to Rs. 5 lakh in Andhra Pradesh.

short_description: Universal health coverage providing cashless medical treatment of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family (and Rs. 10 lakh for women members) per year in Odisha.
eligibility: All BSKY smart health card holders, NFSA card holders, and SFSS card holders residing in Odisha.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana / Ayushman Rajasthan
short_description: Provides universal health insurance coverage for cashless hospitalization across empanelled government and private hospitals in Rajasthan.
eligibility: All permanent resident families of Rajasthan (free for NFSA, SECC, small/marginal farmers, and subsidized for other families).

short_description: Integrated health insurance scheme providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year in Kerala.
eligibility: Poor and vulnerable families enrolled under PM-JAY and state priority beneficiary lists in Kerala.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana (UP-MMJAY)
short_description: Provides cashless treatment cover of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for eligible families left out from SECC 2011 lists in Uttar Pradesh.
eligibility: Eligible Antyodaya card holders, registered construction workers, and vulnerable families residing in Uttar Pradesh.

short_description: Provides cashless hospitalization and surgical treatment coverage up to Rs. 4 lakh for families residing in Goa for over 5 years.
eligibility: Any permanent resident family residing in the State of Goa for 5 years or more.

short_description: Provides financial assistance and cashless medical care for serious illnesses and emergency hospital care in Madhya Pradesh.
eligibility: BPL card holders, Sambal card holders, and vulnerable families residing in Madhya Pradesh.

scheme_name: Delhi Arogya Kosh (DAK) & Delhi Arogya Nidhi
short_description: Provides financial assistance of up to Rs. 5 lakh for treatment of life-threatening diseases, surgeries, and high-end diagnostic tests in Delhi.
eligibility: Permanent residents of the National Capital Territory of Delhi with annual family income up to Rs. 3 lakh holding valid voter ID.

short_description: Universal health coverage initiative providing cashless and subsidized treatment at public health institutions and empanelled private hospitals in Karnataka.
eligibility: Eligible BPL (Priority Households) and APL (Non-priority) resident families of Karnataka.

short_description: Provides cashless medical treatment of up to Rs. 2 lakh per individual per year for 6 critical disease categories in Assam.
eligibility: Families with annual income below Rs. 5 lakh residing in Assam; covering cardiovascular, cancer, kidney, neonatal, burns, and neurological disorders.

short_description: Provides universal health insurance coverage of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year with smart card issued in the name of the female head of the family in West Bengal.
eligibility: All permanent resident families of West Bengal not covered under any other statutory government health scheme.
